name: Anime reactions
summary: Drops an anime reaction picture when someone says your trigger words, or mentions a mood. You set the words, the chance and the mode.
description:
Reactions without any reaction service: the bot decides in Python. Write your own trigger words and phrases per category (one line each, like “happy@80: yay, good news”, where @80 is that line's own chance), or switch on the general mode, where mentioning a mood (sad, thinking, surprised, dance, lunch…) is enough. Pick words, category or both, set how likely a trigger is to fire, the cooldown per channel, which categories and channels are allowed, and whether the bot replies or just posts.

15 categories: angry, calm-down, confused, dance, embarrassed-nervous, happy, lunch-break-time, misc, no, pre-exercise, sad, smug, surprised, thinking, yes. Commands: !react [category], !reactions, and for owners !reactadd and !reactremove.

The pictures aren't inside this module: 300+ reaction pictures, all optimized to 512×512 and under 1 MB, are downloaded once from this marketplace when first needed and cached. You can also use your own folder (data/reactions/images/<category>/, or another folder in Settings). The pictures come from the shadorki/anime-reaction-api collection and belong to their artists. This module runs Python, so it needs Settings → Marketplace → Allow modules with code.
author: lucky-edgelord

images.caption: A trigger word posts a reaction, with the chance you set
Your own words, the general category mode, or both

settings.label: Trigger mode
settings.help: words: only your trigger lines. category: mentioning a mood is enough. both: your words first, then the mood.

settings.label: Trigger words
settings.help: One line per category: “happy: yay, good news”. Add @chance to a line (“sad@80: rip”). Use “any” for a random category. A line starting with # is off.
settings.default:
happy: yay, hooray, good news
sad: rip, f in chat
yes: sounds good, will do
no: absolutely not, nope
dance: let's party

settings.label: Categories allowed
settings.help: Leave empty for all 15. Limits the general mode and random picks.

settings.label: Pictures from
settings.help: auto: your folder when the category has pictures there, else download. local: only your folder. online: only download.

settings.label: Text under the header
settings.help: Optional line in the embed under the category title. {user} is the person's name.

settings.label: Picture folder
settings.help: Folders named like the categories, each with pictures. Blank: data/reactions/images

settings.label: Picture host
settings.help: Where the pictures are downloaded from, as <host>/<category>/<picture>. Default: this marketplace.
